//: Framework-agnostic domain layer typecheck. This config covers the pure TypeScript identity/crypto/store logic that has no React Native dependency, so it compiles and is verified in CI (Node/Turborepo) without the Expo native toolchain. The React Native UI (app/**, src/components/**, src/ui/**) is typechecked separately via `typecheck:app` using expo/tsconfig.base, which requires the Expo SDK to be installed.
